title: SKIN LESIONS
patientLock: N'Gavu — young Black man, mustard-yellow party jacket likeness, thin mustache, tired bloodshot eyes; hospital gown on ED stretcher; blistered dorsal hands and forearms, fragile skin; mustard-yellow shirt draped on bedside chair; two brown beer bottles on overbed side table (patient property); MeWorld sculptural CGI clinical still

orders.label: Urine porphyrins
orders.why: Porphyrins keep building in the skin until you measure them — elevated uroporphyrins confirm the photosensitive pathway.

orders.label: Plasma porphyrins
orders.why: Circulating porphyrin peak at 620 nm locks the diagnosis when urine is equivocal.

orders.label: HCV / HIV / Iron studies
orders.why: Acquired PCT is often triggered by alcohol, iron overload, or silent hepatitis — the rash is not the whole story.

orders.label: Phlebotomy
orders.why: First-line when iron overload is driving the process — target ferritin low-normal.

orders.label: Sun protection / Avoid alcohol
orders.why: Sunlight activates porphyrins in skin; alcohol keeps the trigger running — both must stop.

prequel.title: Village party
prequel.caption: N'Gavu drinks with friends from the village — beer all night, yellow jacket, laughter. He thinks nothing of it.

prequel.title: Afternoon sun
